info.title: Continuum AI IAM API
info.description: Review-first IAM contract. Login, current identity, logout and the A-02 backend refresh HTTP route are implemented. The A-01 session contract's dated A-02 amendment closes refresh response and cookie details; browser BFF routing is tracked separately. Project create/list/detail and Project Access & Visibility V1 operations are accepted; other operations remain proposed or unresolved. Browser authentication uses HttpOnly cookies. Bearer consumption is supported, while programmatic token acquisition is deferred. Tokens are never returned in browser JSON responses.

post.description: Authenticates an active user, stores only a hash of the initial refresh credential, sets access and refresh HttpOnly cookies plus a readable CSRF cookie, and returns the selected user identity without tokens. If the verified account belongs to multiple organizations, returns 409 with eligible organization names and IDs. Invalid credentials use a generic response.

Set-Cookie.description: Three separate fields: continuum_access (HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=900; Secure in production), __Secure-refresh (Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=604800; no Domain), and __Host-csrf (Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain; not HttpOnly). Never combine fields with commas.

post.description: Backend A-02 refresh HTTP contract. The browser uses the Next.js BFF public URL at this same path. Request credentials are the HttpOnly __Secure-refresh cookie, readable __Host-csrf cookie, and matching X-CSRF-Token header; no JSON refresh-token request is accepted. Successful rotation commits before issuing replacement cookies. See the dated A-02 amendment in docs/decisions/auth-session-contract-a-01.md.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Matches the readable __Host-csrf cookie. NestJS validates before refresh-session mutation.

parameters.name: __Host-csrf
parameters.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain.

200.description: Refresh credential rotated once and replacement cookies issued after transaction commit.

Set-Cookie.description: Two separate fields, never comma-joined: continuum_access (Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=900; Secure in production) and __Secure-refresh (Path=/api/v1/auth; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=604800; no Domain).

post.description: Idempotently clears access and refresh cookies at their issued paths. A presented valid access token is revoked for its remaining lifetime; a presented refresh session is revoked by hash before confirmation.

Set-Cookie.description: Separate clearing fields for continuum_access at Path=/ and __Secure-refresh at Path=/api/v1/auth.

get.description: Loads the active user from a valid cookie or bearer access token.
Returns users visible in the caller's organization scope.

patch.description: Updates mutable profile or account-status fields. Only an organization Admin may change status.

post.summary: Provision an Organization and its first ADMIN
post.description: Requires the exact A-04 permission organization.create at PLATFORM scope. Creates only the Organization and its first active ADMIN membership/role assignment in one transaction. The Platform Operator is not made an Organization member or ADMIN. This operation does not grant ongoing membership/role management or content access.

201.description: Organization created with first ADMIN bootstrap and audit record committed atomically.

get.description: Requires platform.health.read at PLATFORM scope. Reuses the existing IAM health response and exposes only operational status metadata. It does not return configuration, secrets, credentials, or Organization content.

Requires platform.audit.read at PLATFORM scope. Returns a bounded, projected subset of Organization provisioning and Platform authority lifecycle metadata only. It excludes mixed metadata, Organization security events, Project records, tokens, secrets, credentials, and private content.

200.description: At most 100 newest safe platform operational audit records.

get.description: Returns Project metadata visible to the authenticated User in the trusted Organization. Users with an ACTIVE Organization Membership may read PUBLIC Project metadata; PRIVATE Projects require the documented Project read policy. Organization Admins may list all organization Projects. Nested Project resources are outside this endpoint contract.

post.description: Any authenticated User with an ACTIVE Organization Membership in the trusted Organization Context may create a Project in that Organization. New Projects are PRIVATE. An ADMIN or TEAM_LEADER role and a project.create capability grant are not required. Creation bootstraps the creator as an ACTIVE ProjectMembership with a project-scoped MEMBER RoleAssignment, but does not make the creator a Project Leader, owner, or Team. A provisioned current MEMBER Role with project.read is required for the bootstrap; the Project, membership, assignment, and project.create audit event are committed atomically.

get.description: Returns Project metadata when the authenticated User has visibility in the trusted Organization. An ACTIVE Organization member may read PUBLIC Project metadata. PRIVATE Projects require the documented Project read policy. Nested Project resources are outside this endpoint contract.

patch.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.visibility.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. Allows PRIVATE to PUBLIC only; PUBLIC to PRIVATE is not supported by V1. An already-PUBLIC active Project returns 409 after authorization succeeds. The mutation is audited in continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam. Project content permissions are unchanged.

get.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, ACTIVE ProjectMembership, a matching project-scoped TEAM_LEADER RoleAssignment, and project.members.list in the resolved Role.permissions. An organization-scoped ADMIN assignment alone does not authorize member listing. Returns membership identifiers, status, and join time; it does not return user profile fields or conflate membership with role assignment.

post.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, ACTIVE ProjectMembership, a matching project-scoped TEAM_LEADER RoleAssignment, and project.members.add in the resolved Role.permissions. An organization-scoped ADMIN assignment alone does not authorize adding members. The target must be an active User with ACTIVE OrganizationMembership in the Project's Organization. Creates ACTIVE ProjectMembership with the current MEMBER RoleAssignment; no leader or owner privilege is added.

patch.description: Proposed only; no generic ProjectMembership PATCH is enabled in Project Access & Visibility V1. Membership changes use the explicit add/remove operations. The project.members.role.change permission is disabled and must not be provisioned. A Project Leader cannot self-escalate, assign TEAM_LEADER to another User, or change another Project Leader. This operation is not implemented.

delete.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, ACTIVE ProjectMembership, a matching project-scoped TEAM_LEADER RoleAssignment, and project.members.remove in the resolved Role.permissions. An organization-scoped ADMIN assignment alone does not authorize removing members. Changes an ACTIVE ProjectMembership to INACTIVE without deleting ProjectMembership or RoleAssignment history. Idempotent: an already-INACTIVE membership or repeated DELETE returns 204 without another state transition or audit event. An ACTIVE to INACTIVE change is audited in continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam.

204.description: Membership is absent from the active project view; repeated DELETE also returns 204.

post.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.leader.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. The target must already have ACTIVE OrganizationMembership and ACTIVE ProjectMembership in this Project. Assigns the existing TEAM_LEADER Role at Project scope. The event is written to continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam.

put.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.leader.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. Atomically changes one current Project Leader to another active Project member with a current MEMBER RoleAssignment. It changes no ProjectMembership. The continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam action is PROJECT_LEADER_CHANGED; the current contract records the affected RoleAssignment IDs but has no before/after snapshot fields.

delete.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.leader.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. Downgrades the project-scoped RoleAssignment to the current MEMBER Role and retains ACTIVE ProjectMembership. The event is written to continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam.

post.description: The user must already have an active membership in the team's project.

delete.description: Idempotently removes the membership from the team. The containing team must exist.

204.description: Membership is absent from the team.

refreshCookie.name: __Secure-refresh
refreshCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly browser refresh credential; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1/auth so both refresh and logout receive it; no Domain.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access JWT accepted for programmatic/API callers. A trusted programmatic acquisition and refresh flow is deferred; browser login returns no token JSON.

RefreshInvalid.description: Generic invalid refresh credential, including known revoked-token replay. No replacement cookies.

RefreshCsrfInvalid.description: Missing or mismatched CSRF values. No refresh-session mutation or replacement cookies.

RefreshFailed.description: Internal or transaction failure. No replacement cookies or database details.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, expired or revoked.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated caller lacks permission for the requested scope.

NotFound.description: The addressed resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing unique resource or current state. User status updates can return LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN or SHARED_ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGE.

OrganizationSelectionRequired.description: The password was verified, but an organization must be selected. The details.organizations array contains only organizations assigned to this account.

ValidationFailed.description: The JSON request is understood but violates field or business validation.

TooManyRequests.description: The request exceeded the applicable rate limit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the caller may retry.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: UTC Unix timestamp when the current window resets.

ResourceId.description: Opaque resource identifier. Clients must not infer its storage format.

UtcTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp normalized to UTC with a trailing Z.

details.description: Machine-readable context. Use an empty object when no additional context is safe to expose.
